title: RepoCreated
description: The CI/CD adapter created a repo an architect approved for a run's scope: a skeleton for its technology, a CI check and, where GitHub allows it, branch protection on the default branch (ADR 0018). Topic hotl.run; subject and key: the run id. Producer: CI/CD adapter. Main consumers: Onboarder, harvesters, orchestrator.

technology.description: The skeleton it was created with, for example go.

commit.description: The skeleton's commit on the default branch.

ciCheck.description: The check run the skeleton's CI workflow reports, which gates merges.

protected.description: True when GitHub enforces the default branch's ruleset.

protection.description: Why the default branch is not protected, when it is not.
